title: Flashbatch
description: Queue and render every scene of a Flashback replay at once, with full control over naming, export settings, and time ranges — instead of adding scenes to the queue one by one.
body:
# FlashBatch

**FlashBatch** is a companion mod for [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback) that lets you queue and render every scene of the same replay at once, instead of adding each scene to the export queue one by one.

## What it does

FlashBatch adds a **Queue All Scenes...** entry to Flashback's main menu bar. Clicking it opens a batch export window, styled to match Flashback's own editor UI, where you can configure exactly how every scene gets exported before queuing them all in one click.

## Features

- **Custom filename patterns** - use Flashback's own placeholders (`%seq%`, `%scene%`, `%date%`, `%time%`, `%replay%`) with a live preview of the resolved name. Set a custom starting number for `%seq%` whenever you need one.
- **Full export options** - resolution, framerate, projection, container/codec/encoder, bitrate, transparency, SSAA, audio settings... the same options Flashback's own export window offers, kept independent from your saved Preferences so batch exports never overwrite your usual defaults.
- **Custom output folder** per batch, with a folder picker.
- **Time range selector** - choose whether each scene exports using its In/Out points, its first/last keyframe, or the full recorded footage, with automatic fallback if the chosen source is empty for a given scene.
- **Per-scene selection** - all scenes are included by default, with an optional checklist to exclude specific ones.
- **Settings are remembered** between game sessions.

Nothing renders automatically: FlashBatch only queues the jobs into Flashback's own render queue, exactly as if you had clicked "Add to Queue" on every scene yourself.

## Requirements

- [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
